I'm a postdoc at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen, where I'm working in the [Copenhagen Causality Lab](https://cocala.github.io/). Currently, I'm visiting the [Causal inference program](https://www.newton.ac.uk/event/cif/) at the Isaac Newton Institute in Cambridge.

Previously, I was a PhD student in the [Statistical Methods for Causal Inference](https://www.bips-institut.de/en/the-institute/departments/statistical-methods-in-epidemiology/statistical-methods-for-causal-inference.html) group at the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology - BIPS in Bremen.

In August, I will join the [Center for Statistics](https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/departments/department-finance/center-statistics) at Copenhagen Business School as an assistant professor.

My research interests include graphical models and causal inference, and my current work is focused on causal discovery.
